average.what: ERCT subregion total output CO2 rate (SRCO2RTA), generation basis
average.source: EPA eGRID2023 rev2 (12 June 2025), egrid2023_data_rev2.xlsx, sheet SRL23

marginal.what: Texas region avoided CO2 rate for uniform energy efficiency (a flat load all year), adjusted for transmission and distribution losses
marginal.source: EPA AVERT v4.3 avoided emission rates, 2023 data, avert_emission_rates_04-11-24.xlsx, sheet 2023, row 32 (Uniform EE)

marginal_check.what: ERCT non-baseload output CO2 rate (SRNBCO2), generation basis

gas_co2_kg_per_mmbtu.source: EPA GHG Emission Factors Hub 2025 (15 January 2025), Table 1, natural gas

eia_coverage_pct.what: Percent of Texas industrial natural gas deliveries included in EIA's industrial price (N3035TX4)

zuberi.capital: electric boiler capital cost nearly 40% less than an equivalent natural gas boiler (p.43)
zuberi.source: Zuberi, Hasanbeigi & Morrow, Electrification of Boilers in U.S. Manufacturing, LBNL-2001436, November 2021

energy_usd_mwh.basis: Charges per MWh of load on the ERCOT side, from the market monitor (Potomac Economics 2025 and 2024 State of the Market reports): ancillary services $0.39 (2025) and $0.98 (2024) per MWh of load; uplift $1.38 (2025) and $1.24 (2024) per MWh, which includes ERCOT's $0.61/MWh administrative fee (Market Notice M-A111125-01); Subchapter N securitization about $0.29/MWh (derived from ERCOT's Sept 2026 true-up filing and 2025 load; zero for a load that opted out) and Subchapter M about $0.06/MWh. Low: 2025 AS + uplift + M = 1.83. Central: the 2024-25 averages + N + M = 2.35. High: 2024 + N + M = 2.57.

demand_usd_kw_yr.basis: Delivery (TDSP) charges for a transmission-voltage customer, per kW of the boiler. No per-kWh delivery charge applies (Oncor and CenterPoint for-profit transmission service). Low: CenterPoint, whose every demand charge is on 4CP kVA, with the boiler never on in a 4CP interval; or a boiler behind a meter whose peak other load sets. Central: Oncor, the boiler setting the meter's NCP: Distribution System Charge $0.331004 + Rider RCE $0.005241 + DCRF $0.010072 per NCP kW-month = $0.346317 x 12 = $4.16 per kW-yr (Oncor Tariff for Retail Delivery Service s.6.1.1.1.7, interim rates eff. 4 Oct 2026, PUCT 59249). High: central plus being on at full load in one of the four summer 4CP intervals: TCRF $6.260839 per 4CP kW-month x 0.25 x 12 = $18.78 per kW-yr. Fixed customer and metering charges (a few hundred dollars a month per point of delivery) are left out.

electric_boiler_capital_usd_kw.basis: LBNL-2001436 Appendix B, Figure B-1 (p.43): investment cost of an electric boiler, 2018 $/kW, from about 160 for boilers under 2.9 MW to about 46 for boilers over 73 MW (read from the chart; the text gives the range as 13 to 44 $/GJ); equipment and installation, grid connection excluded. The model's own default, $30,000 per MMBtu/h of heat output, is $100 per kW of electric input.

discount_rate_note: The model's 8 per cent real rate is an assumption (LBNL-2001436 uses 10 per cent, pp.20-21).
